Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<T>, Collection<T>, List<T>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<T>
public class PlotGraphList<T extends PlotGraph<T>> extends ArrayList<T>
A type-safe list for storing plot graph instances of a specific concrete type. This class extends ArrayList to provide a dedicated container that preserves the self-referential generic type relationship defined by PlotGraph.
